review_scope: Bounded public primary-source review; no provider contact, private covariance or full-text access claimed.

sources.location: INTRODUCTION; ACCESSING THE JPL PLANETARY EPHEMERIDES
sources.finding: Nominal Chebyshev positions/velocities use km and TDB days; export documentation distinguishes DE440 and DE441 dynamics.
sources.limitation: Nominal series do not supply the required joint fitted covariance or integrated clock response.

sources.finding: DE440 and DE441 use the same fitting data but differ in lunar core/mantle damping; the time ephemeris is integrated with dynamical inputs.
sources.limitation: A release label, nominal constants or model comparisons cannot certify a source-matched covariance receipt.

sources.location: directory description and file inventory inspected 2026-10-21 UTC
sources.finding: Catalog lists TCB/TDB headers, ASCII archives, binary files, TCBtcg/TDBtt time files, SPICE archive, README and testpo files.
sources.limitation: No complete covariance/trajectory-response product was identified in this inspected listing; this is not a global absence claim.

sources.location: release note S110, June 2021; release model and orbital comparisons
sources.finding: The release note supplies INPOP21a model and observational comparison context.
sources.limitation: It did not establish an acquired, complete clock covariance with parameter ordering and trajectory response for the archived kernel.

sources.finding: Authors explicitly use INPOP21a covariance and partial derivatives for lunar libration, with a reference epoch described as J2000; section 3 includes simulated new lunar observations.
sources.limitation: Angular marginal uncertainties and figures do not provide the complete joint planetary covariance or geocentric clock response. Do not infer numeric epoch/scale or zeros for missing correlations.

sources.finding: The separate 2026 paper describes lunar PA/ME reference realizations, Euler-angle uncertainty propagation and lunar timescales.
sources.limitation: Full publisher HTML/PDF and institutional PDF returned HTTP 403. Only the abstract and linked CDS supplement were reviewed; full-text conclusions and data availability remain unverified.

sources.location: Description, File Summary and byte-by-byte table
sources.finding: Supplement lists isigma.dat, p1.dat, p2.dat, rho.dat and tau.dat: lunar librational/polar series with Fourier and Poisson coefficients.
sources.limitation: The inspected supplement is not a complete fit covariance plus integrated geocentric clock Jacobian.

sources.location: query parameters cov/full-prec/soln-epoch; covariance output fields
sources.finding: Small-body covariance is tied to solution epoch (TDB JD), ordered labels and fitted parameters. mat/vec use au, deg, d; src square-root format uses au, rad, d. Upper-triangle vectors are column-major.
sources.limitation: An asteroid/comet covariance, including one computed using a named planetary ephemeris, is not that planetary solution covariance. No SBDB product is ingested.

sources.location: statistical uncertainty quantities; close-approach uncertainty discussion
sources.finding: Documented asteroid/comet formal uncertainty propagation uses a linearized model; systematic error and long propagation or encounters can invalidate optimistic interpretation.
sources.limitation: Statistical output does not establish geocentric clock covariance or a deterministic physical bound.
